title: diagram-design: a Claude Code skill that turns your agent into an editorial graphic designer

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Diagram design is a clawed code skill built by someone tired of fighting Figma for 30 minutes every time she needed an architecture sketch. Your agent becomes a high-end editorial graphic designer generating stunning self-contained HTML and SVG files. Zero JavaScript, zero external images, zero build steps. 13 built-in structural types, including sequence diagrams, state machines, vend diagrams, and swim lanes.
